purpose: Small controlled context-consumption probe, not a full Agent rollout or general ability benchmark
scope: Synthetic development probes designed by the implementer. Single observations per cell. No holdout/generalization or causal module-isolation claim.

metrics.field_accuracy: correct applicable gold fields / applicable gold fields; transport and malformed responses fail their fields
metrics.case_success: all applicable fields correct / all planned task-variant cells; unstarted cells are incomplete
metrics.tokens: known provider input/output usage, missing counts separate
metrics.exposure: required evidence present and foreign-goal content absent in prepared context, separately from model answers

limitations: Representations differ across variants; not a single-factor effect estimate
No tool autonomy, code-repair score, multi-day retention or stability claim
No paid search or embedding calls
Actual billed cost unavailable unless provider exposes it
rules: freeze task, oracle, runner and current source hashes before first live call
no gold edits or reruns based on results
each live call reserved on disk before dispatch
stop on authentication/payment failure and preserve remaining unstarted slots
